name: com.foreverworks/google
title: Google Workspace
description: MCP server for several Google accounts at once

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path of your OAuth client's JSON (a Desktop app client from the Google Cloud console).

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_ADDRESSES
environmentVariables.description: Each account's label and address, e.g. personal=ana@example.com,work=ana@example.org.

environmentVariables.name: GMAIL_MODIFY_ACCOUNTS
environmentVariables.description: For Gmail: where each mailbox's grant is kept, e.g. personal=/path/to/grants/gmail-personal.json.

environmentVariables.name: CALENDAR_TIME_ZONE
environmentVariables.description: The time zone a time without an offset is read in, e.g. Europe/Paris.
